rationale: Both Kevin and Angelo are focused on fintech-b2b and can offer each other real value—Kevin brings hands-on data analytics experience from a credit union, while Angelo is building compliance and trust infrastructure for financial services. intro_message: Kevin Jia, meet Angelo Kalaw—Angelo's building trust and compliance infrastructure for fintech, and your credit union data analytics background could offer valuable perspective on how those solutions work in practice.
